title: VSWR-Protected Silicon Bipolar Power Amplifier with Smooth Power Control Slope Angelo Scuderi1, Antonino Scuderi2, Francesco Carrara1, Giuseppe Palmisano1
figure_number: Figure 10.7.1 shows a simplified schematic of the proposed amplifier. The circuit is composed of three gain stages (T1-T3). On-chip inter-stage matching networks were designed for maximum gain under large-signal conditions. A bond-wire inductance and capacitor were used between the first and second stages, while two capacitors and a spiral inductor were employed between the second and third stages. An on-chip input matching network was also implemented by means of two bond-wire inductances at the emitter and base of the first stage. An output series-resonant load was used to improve PA efficiency. Bond-wire inductance LW and a partially distributed output matching network were suitably employed to provide a high reactive impedance for the harmonics of the fundamental frequency (mixed-C mode or Class C-E). A bias circuit was included allowing a power control function to be achieved by varying the collector quiescent current of each stage through the external voltage VCTRL.
